about: Ushanti Colour Chem Ltd manufactures dyes, pigments, additives and intermediates for textile, paper, leather, paint, plastic and ink applications. It operates the legacy Vatva business and consolidates 51%-owned UC Colours and Intermediates Pvt Ltd, which houses the Saykha project. [1] [2]
